# Steven D. Rhoads (R): NYS Senate, District 5

<!-- Generated by build.py from meta.json and claims.csv. Do not edit by hand. -->

Independent, source-by-source review of the claims on **Steven D. Rhoads's** campaign website ([Meet Steve page](https://www.steverhoads.com/meet-steve-rhoads)), captured **2026-11-26**. Incumbent. Opponent: [Andrew Piddoubny](../piddoubny-andrew/) (D).

**Live site:** <https://rike4545.github.io/LI-CandidateCheck/#/c/rhoads-steven> · method: [METHODOLOGY.md](../../METHODOLOGY.md)

> Scope: this review tests whether each claim is **verifiable** and **accurate as stated**. It does not rate the candidate, the opponent, or policy positions.

## Bottom line

The incumbent's biography page. His offices and the 2016 anti-BDS law check out; the $100 million tax-cut figure and the no-tax-increase record are his own characterizations with no breakdown.

1. County Legislature service from 2015 and his Senate term are on the public record.
2. Nassau's 2016 anti-BDS law exists, but the "first county in the nation" claim was not confirmed.
